startup.name: ContractGuard
startup.one_liner: Detect API changes and prepare tested migrations for affected customer repositories.
startup.problem: API vendors ship breaking changes that create downtime, emergency engineering work, and integration risk for customer teams.
startup.solution: Normalize API contracts, identify affected usages in connected repositories, generate migrations, and validate them before opening a PR.
startup.customer: API providers and engineering teams maintaining production integrations
startup.business_model: B2B SaaS priced per connected repository and API provider
startup.market_evidence: Engineering teams already buy observability, CI, dependency management, and API infrastructure. Initial validation targets API vendors with many downstream integrations.
startup.differentiation: Provider-aware contract diff plus repository blast-radius analysis and evidence-backed migration validation.
startup.unfair_advantage: Accumulated API-change-to-code-fix traces improve future migration routing and validation.
startup.traction: Three design partners are testing repository scans; one paid pilot is under negotiation.

founders.name: Founder
founders.bio: Builds developer tooling and API systems.

application_answers.Why now?: Agentic coding tools now make repository-aware automated maintenance practical.
